column1: # exam-grading llama-server profiles -- read by serve.sh / health.sh
# Tab separated. '#' lines are comments. One row per registry model id.
#  1 id          must match a model id in registry.tsv
#  3 port        loopback port for llama-server (127.0.0.1 only)
#  5 temp        default sampling temperature (--temp); 0 for reproducibility
#  6 extra_args  extra llama-server flags, or '-' for none
# Ports are per model so two roles (or two OCR candidates) can run side by side.
# Override any value at run time: PORT=9001 ./serve.sh start ocr
